items.title: AI chatbots regularly link pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosure
items.summary: When asked about unplanned pregnancies, AI chatbots regularly link to anti-abortion groups without disclosing their stance. In an AlgorithmWatch investigation of 270 responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Claude, the anti-abortion organization Profemina appeared in 17 percent of answers. In Germany, the chatbots also sent users to Caritas for mandatory pre-abortion counseling, even though Caritas doesn't issue the legally required certificate. The article AI chatbots regularly link pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosure appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Canonical研究自動將大型C程式碼庫轉成Rust，結合LLM與程式驗證降低遷移風險
items.summary: Canonical與英國布里斯托大學展開3年研究合作，研究如何提高C程式自動轉成Rust的可靠度，目標是建立一套完整轉換平臺，處理數十萬行C程式碼的大型儲存庫。研究將結合大型語言模型、程式分析、測試與形式化方法（formal methods），除了產生Rust程式碼，也要確認轉換後的程式維持原本行為，降低大型軟體遷移需要人工修正的成本與風險。

items.title: 能管法三讀修正，因應AI用電需求，新設能源大戶須設自用發電或儲能設備
items.summary: 立法院8月21日三讀通過「能源管理法」部分條文修正案，經濟部在今天(8/24)表示，此次共增修15條條文，修法聚焦公開能源銷售統計資料、強化企業能源供應韌性、提升地方政府節能稽查能力及提高違規罰則。其中，新增要求新設或增設達一定容量的能源大用戶設置自用發電設備或儲能設備，被視為這次修法最受關注的內容。 這次修法中提出的「Bring Your Own Power」（自帶電力」概念，為目前國際上針對AI資料中心興起的趨勢，在立法院審議之前，行政院今年5月通過的修法草案時即已納入。當時行政院將修法定位為因應能源需求面管理及推動深度節能，希望透過法制強化企業自主節能責任，提升能源使用效率與電網韌性。

items.title: Anthropic’s best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive
items.summary: Anthropic’s best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive A few interesting numbers in this FT story gathered from "people with knowledge of the matter": Anthropic's "annualized revenue" for July is up to $65bn - it was $47bn in May, and I collected more historic numbers here . Anthropic expect Q3 to be profitable according to the same model they used to declare Q2 profitable. "It also told investors that it had 6,000 customers that spend $100,000 annually or more." As for OpenAI, "annualised revenue has jumped 35 per cent in the quarter to date and is now over $40bn, with the launch of GPT 5.6 in July jolting the company’s performance after a sluggish start to the year". This article also introduced me to the Ramp AI index , which uses billing data from 70,000 Ramp credit card using companies to estimate model adoption. Here's Ramp's breakdown of Anthropic model spend for July 2026, which looks reasonable given that Opus 5 was only released on July 24th, and supports the idea that Fable's cost has made it a less popular model: Opus 4.8: 28.0% Sonnet 4.6: 8.3% Fable 5: 8.0% Opus 4.6: 6.9% Sonnet 5: 3.6% Opus 5: 3.5% Opus 4.7: 1.7% Sonnet 4.5: 1.3% Haiku 4.5: 1.0% Opus 4.5: 0.7% Via Hacker News Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , claude-mythos-fable

items_ai.summary: When asked about unplanned pregnancies, AI chatbots regularly link to anti-abortion groups without disclosing their stance. In Germany, the chatbots also sent users to Caritas for mandatory pre-abortion counseling, even though Caritas doesn't issue the legally required certificate. items_ai.summary: 立法院8月21日三讀通過「能源管理法」部分條文修正案，經濟部在今天(8/24)表示，此次共增修15條條文，修法聚焦公開能源銷售統計資料、強化企業能源供應韌性、提升地方政府節能稽查能力及提高違規罰則。其中，新增要求新設或增設達一定容量的能源大用戶設置自用發電設備或儲能設備，被視為這次修法最受關注的內容。 這次修法中提出的「Bring Your Own Power」（自帶電力」概念，為目前國際上針對AI資料中心興起的趨勢，在立法院審議之前，行政院今年5月通過的修法草案時即已納入。當時行政院將修法定位為因應能源需求面管理及推動深度節能，希望透過法制強化企業自主節能責任，提升能源使用效率與電網韌性。

Anthropic expect Q3 to be profitable according to the same model they used to declare Q2 profitable. "It also told investors that it had 6,000 customers that spend $100,000 annually or more." As for OpenAI, "annualised revenue has jumped 35 per cent in the quarter to date and is now over $40bn, with the launch of GPT 5.6 in July jolting the company’s performance after a sluggish start to the year". This article also introduced me to the Ramp AI index , which uses billing data from 70,000 Ramp credit card using companies to estimate model adoption. Here's Ramp's breakdown of Anthropic model spend for July 2026, which looks reasonable given that Opus 5 was only released on July 24th, and supports the idea that Fable's cost has made it a less popular model: Opus 4.8: 28.0% Sonnet 4.6: 8.3% Fable 5: 8.0% Opus 4.6: 6.9% Sonnet 5: 3.6% Opus 5: 3.5% Opus 4.7: 1.7% Sonnet 4.5: 1.3% Haiku 4.5: 1.0% Opus 4.5: 0.7% Via Hacker News Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , claude-mythos-fable
